Panel B, letter B at the upper left: color photograph of an infant lying on a light cloth with bare chest and shoulders, the lower face and chin cropped at the top, and an arm bent at the elbow on the right of the image. The skin on that arm and the chest appears faintly pink and mottled. No text other than the letter is printed.
